intro: The numbers people quote, read from the chain and the Canopy index. They refresh every minute. No wallet addresses are shown, only counts.
emptyIntro: Nothing is armed yet. The numbers fill in as people arm their positions.

footnote: Counts only the vaults Canopy lists. Armed value is each owner's exitable shares times the vault's share price, in dollars of the vault's asset. Canopy is software. It tries to exit when your alarms fire and promises no outcome.
